buy: Buick-designed 225 cu in Dauntless V6 (155 hp) becomes optional; by 1968 about 75% of CJ-5s have it
owner: The CJ-5 outlived three corporate owners, four engine families and a television hit piece, and it still feels like the original idea of a Jeep with the corners filed off.
